title: Frappe ERPNext 4.3.0 before 15.121.6 and 16.x before 16.37.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in an endpoint of…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions 4.3.0 before 15.121.6 and 16.x before 16.37.0 have an SQL injection vulnerability in an endpoint of the Selling and Buying modules. This flaw allows any authenticated user, including portal users without roles, to send crafted requests that override early validation and reach the database unvalidated. Exploitation can lead to extraction of sensitive data such as active session information and account takeover, including administrator accounts.
